verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own programmatic surfaces: an 'API Club' giving one API for 100+ video, image, audio and LLM models, and a Pika MCP that brings '40+ creative apps and 100+ gen media models' into agent conversations. That suggests much of the creative tooling is reachable outside the UI. Nothing shows that every UI feature is exposed, though. The listed apps (Pikaframes, Swap Anything, Camera Director, captions, etc.) are not explicitly mapped to API endpoints, and account, credit and plan management via API is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API reference docs mapping each UI app to endpoints, programmatic account/billing/credit management, independent or hands-on corroboration of API coverage.
